[[File:Aurilianplant.png|thumb|250px|A large Aurilian plant]]
An '''Aurilian plant''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was notoriously difficult to grow and maintain. Each individual plant was unique in its requirements which would change over its lifecycle. With proper care, it would bear [[Aurilian fruit]]. The plant was given by [[Sivarra Mecheaux]] who resided in the village of [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to players as a reward.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Large Aurilian Plant}}</ref>
